# Overview

This article, published on Nexos, presents the main findings and policy implications of our academic study on the *Zona Libre de la Frontera Norte:* Mexico’s Northern Border Free Zone program. The summary, written in Spanish for a general audience, explains the methodology and highlights the positive effect of the program on the gross state product of Baja California.

::: {.callout-caution}
In the figure included in the Nexos post, the legend labels are inverted: **“Observado”** corresponds to the **black** line, and **“Ficticio”** to the **gray** line.
:::
